purpose: record, after deployment and verification, that the release is accepted in production and operations has taken over
entry_criteria: Production deployment and smoke test are complete
Observation window has ended or has an agreed end
Monitoring and on-call coverage are active
procedure: Review the deployment and smoke test records for the exact release id.
Check metrics and alerts through the observation window against the baseline.
Confirm open issues are fixed, accepted by owners or ticketed with a decision.
Confirm the rollback path is no longer needed or is explicitly retained.
Record accepted, accepted with conditions or rejected with reasons and the people who decided.
Hand over to operations and close the change record.
acceptance_criteria: Sign-off names the exact release id
Metrics stayed within thresholds through the window
Change record is closed with the outcome
validation_method: Release manager sign-off with the production approver informed.

validation.check: compare error rate and latency for the window to the pre-release baseline
confirm the release id in the record equals the deployed one

failure_modes.mode: Signed off before the window ends
failure_modes.detection: Timestamp earlier than the window end
Incident linked to the release is still open
failure_modes.response: Resolve or record as a condition

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: After two hours of normal metrics and no open issues, the release manager records acceptance for release 2.4.0 and closes the change record.
